ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by approximately 25% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels concentrated on distal margins against 75% low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels in the medial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and contiguous high-intensity patches located at the distal tips of both lobes; solid dark pigmentation dominates the center and lower visible regions of the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes (peaks) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, particularly prominent on the right lobe distal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges transitioning to sharp, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups located primarily on the white-pigmented distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark surface of the right lobe medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or heavy serration along the trailing edges; extensive distal white scarring/pigmentation consistent with long-term abrasive contact.
